children: DA Davidson maintained their Buy rating on PaySign's stock with a price target of $15.00.
The price target implies an upside of 16.7% from the Sep 29 close of $12.85.
Key takeaways from the analyst note
Strong Revenue Growth in Patient Affordability Segment

: PaySign has demonstrated impressive growth in its Pharmaceutical Patient Affordability segment, with a revenue increase of 89% year-over-year in the second quarter, contributing significantly to the company's overall revenue. This momentum is expected to continue, driving higher earnings and reinforcing investor confidence.

: The company has successfully added numerous new campaigns, with management projecting a total of 186 active programs by the end of 2026, up from 43 in 2023. This expansion highlights PaySign's ability to capture market share and generate diverse revenue streams, further supporting its Buy rating.
